# Learnings

What the agents working in this project learned: executors in their goal
retrospectives, the orchestrator after a reap, the planner whenever it
learns something. Read the entries that touch the area you are about to
change; add one with `evie-kit learnings add`.

- [Container root without DAC capabilities](container-root-without-dac.md) — no DAC_OVERRIDE: switch to the owner for 0700 dirs; setpriv needs SETPCAP; redis image has no procps
- [userdel removes Debian private groups](debian-userdel-private-groups.md) — USERGROUPS_ENAB yes makes userdel delete the user's group; reconcile before groupdel
- [macOS accounts inherit nested groups](macos-inherited-groups.md) — derive the groups every local account inherits at run time; never a fixed list
- [Root scripts and untrusted account paths](root-scripts-untrusted-paths.md) — root must not follow links or write into a less-privileged account's paths
- [Absence queries must fail closed](shell-absence-queries.md) — a failed query inside a test substitution reads as absent; capture and fail first
